grids.mode: MODE B: High Density Dashboard Grid

layouts.sidebar: Fixed 260px dark slate sidebar (#0F172A) with company logo, operational navigation items with status badge counts, active indicator highlight, user profile pill, and collapsed tablet view.
layouts.header: Top bar (#FFFFFF) sticky z-40 with global search bar, active order quick jumper, role indicator tag, notifications popover, and company name 'Title Search Services'.

motion.principles: Subtle, non-distracting functional micro-interactions. Responsive hover transforms (y: -1px), smooth tab transitions, instant filter response, and explicit loading skeletons.

accessibility.apca_wcag_standard: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all body and muted copy on page and card surfaces).
accessibility.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid to every button, link, search input, filter dropdown, table row, tab trigger, dialog trigger, and form control (e.g., data-testid='create-order-button', data-testid='order-status-filter').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SYSTEM ROLE & BRAND: Title Search Services - Enterprise Title Search Order Management & Report Automation App. Clean, structured, high-density, professional business application.
2. CORE PAGES & ROUTES TO IMPLEMENT IN frontend/src/pages/:

- Dashboard.tsx (/): Stat cards (Total Orders, New, In Progress, Pending Review, Completed, Overdue), Quick Actions, Recent Orders Table, Orders Due Soon widget, Assigned to Me list, Search & Quick Filter.

- OrdersList.tsx (/orders): Dense data table with advanced multi-select, global search, status filters (NEW, IN PROGRESS, DOCUMENTS COLLECTED, REPORT PREPARATION, PENDING REVIEW, APPROVED, COMPLETED, ON HOLD, CANCELLED), assignee filter, pagination, bulk status update, and export controls.
- CreateOrder.tsx (/orders/new): Multi-section wizard form (Client Info, Property Details, Search Specs, Document Requirements, Priority & Deadlines, Assignees). Includes pre-fill demo button.
- OrderWorkspace.tsx (/orders/:id): Master order view with 8 TABS:
a. Tab 1 - Overview: Summary metrics, status timeline stepper, quick action buttons (Generate AI Report, Export ZIP, Change Status).
b. Tab 2 - Order Details: Complete property, legal description, APN, county, buyer/seller/lender metadata form with edit mode.
c. Tab 3 - Documents: Drag-and-drop file uploader (PDF/DOCX/JPG/PNG/TIFF), raw document list, preview drawer, file metadata, document categorization.
d. Tab 4 - Document Information: Structured data extraction form per document (Deed, Mortgage, Lien, Tax Certificate, Easement, Judgment) with large rich-text notes and key entity fields.
e. Tab 5 - Search Findings: Chain of title findings, tax status, encumbrances, liens, restrictions, judgment checks list with risk level badges (Low, Medium, High, Critical).

f. Tab 6 - Summary Report: AI First Draft generator button (non-hallucinating based strictly on uploaded document findings), interactive section-by-section rich editor, version history comparison, approval signature block, PDF/DOCX export.
g. Tab 7 - Activity/History: Complete audit log of document uploads, field edits, status changes, and user comments with timestamps.
h. Tab 8 - Access: Order-specific sharing matrix (assign users, change roles: ADMIN, RESEARCHER, REVIEWER, CLIENT).
- DocumentTimeline.tsx (Title Chain): Visual chronological title chain flow showing property transfers, deeds, mortgages, and releases across history.
- ReportsSummary.tsx (/reports): Aggregated analytics of search report turnaround times, error rates, completed title reports, export logs.
- UsersManagement.tsx (/users): User list, role assignments (ADMIN, RESEARCHER, REVIEWER, CLIENT), invitation modal, access controls.

- Settings.tsx (/settings): Editable company name 'Title Search Services', document type definitions, search source credentials (Netro Online placeholder config), AI prompt customization, email export templates.
3. STATE & SEED DATA:
- Provide rich initial demo data for orders (at least 8-10 realistic title search orders across diverse property types, status states, counties, and deed types).
- Support instant role switching in top navbar (Admin, Researcher, Reviewer, Client) to demonstrate permission gating for UI actions (e.g. Client can only view and download approved reports).
- Implement client-side PDF/DOCX export simulation (using clean formatted HTML printable view or docx/pdf generation) and ZIP package export simulation with manifest.
4. ACCESSIBILITY & STYLING:
- Use font family 'Manrope' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
- Ensure all interactive elements carry clear data-testid attributes.
- Ensure all modal dialogs, select dropdowns, and date pickers use existing @/components/ui components (base-ui/shadcn).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.layout: Avoid centered single-column pages. Use professional sidebar-driven enterprise layouts with clear visual hierarchy, subtle card borders, dense data tables, and distinct status badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.microinteractions: Provide hover feedback, loading spinners on AI report generation, toast notifications (Sonner) on save/upload/export, and clear empty states for lists.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
